note: Anthropic Messages 429 answered to an own-credential OAuth bearer seat, derived from recorded field values: status 429, error.type rate_limit_error, error.message the literal Error, and no retry-after, retry-after-ms or anthropic-ratelimit-* response header on any recorded occurrence. The recordings kept those fields, not the raw body bytes, so the body is set in the documented error envelope (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors) with the request id replaced. headers lists every response header the recognizer reads; an empty list is the recorded absence.
